question: ________ dance icon Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma enjoys a pre-eminent place in the ‘stree-vesham’ hall of fame.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma** is a renowned icon in the **Kuchipudi** dance form.
 
• He is particularly famous for his expertise in **stree-vesham**, which involves male dancers performing female roles.
 
• His contributions have earned him a pre-eminent place in the Kuchipudi dance hall of fame.
 
• Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma has played a significant role in popularizing Kuchipudi both in India and globally.
 
• He has received numerous awards for his exceptional skills and dedication to the art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi**

 
 
• Kuchipudi is one of the eight major Indian classical dances.
 
• It originated in a village named Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The dance form combines fast rhythms and fluid movements, creating a unique style that is both expressive and graceful.
 
• Kuchipudi performances often include intricate footwork, dramatic expressions, and complex hand gestures.
 
• It traditionally involves both dance and acting, often telling stories from Hindu epics and scriptures.
 
 
 
• **Stree-vesham**
 
 
• Stree-vesham refers to the portrayal of female characters by male dancers.
 
• This practice is rooted in ancient Indian theater and dance traditions.
 
• It requires exceptional skill in mimicking female mannerisms and expressions.
 
• Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is celebrated for his mastery of stree-vesham in Kuchipudi.
 
• Stree-vesham performances are often used to depict mythological stories and characters.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Dance Forms**
 
 
• India has eight recognized classical dance forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Kathakali, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
 
• Each dance form has its own unique style, history, and technique.
 
• These dances are known for their intricate footwork, expressive hand gestures, and elaborate costumes.
 
• They often narrate stories from Hindu mythology and Indian folklore.
 
• Classical dances play a significant role in preserving and promoting India's rich cultural heritage.
